question: Three sheets of ties and slurs that are read but not written (sheet 1 Litolff 'unread ink at its end', sheet 2 Litolff 'end too far from its note', sheet 3 Brahms 'runs to the edge of the system'). On those three sheets, is any boxed mark not a tie or slur?
verbatim: 3rd sheet 14 is not an arc. Sheet 1 8 and 9 the boxes are cutting off a good part of the arc. Everything else looks pretty straightforward

answers.subject: obs:138435
answers.answer: the box cuts off a good part of the arc

ours: Sheet 3 tile 14 is an OLD detector tie box (reason enters_from_previous_system), one of the boxes the trace says are mostly not arcs. Sheet 1 tiles 8 and 9 are the SAME page-wide run (obs:138435) drawn twice in the sample, and the box is the run's own ink extent -- so the page reader holds that arc only in part (read short, or in pieces). The other 69 tiles: Sean confirms they are ties or slurs; he did not say which notes each joins.
